messages:
erin.marketing: Heads-up: we need a small, brand-safe asset bundle for the upcoming benchmark post + a short webinar. Scope: 2 social hero tiles (landscape + square), 1 single-slide infographic (latency vs cost tradeoffs), and 1 compact one-column metric card for the blog. Target turnaround: 48 hours. Can design pick this up?

kai.design: Yep we can run it. Quick clarifying qs: exact pixel sizes? Do we need dark mode? Any mandatory legal phrasing?

devin.pm: Sizes: landscape 1200x628, square 800x800, metric card 600x800, slide infographic should be legible at 960px width. Include dark-mode variants only for the hero tiles. Legal: avoid using the term "Redwood Certified" — legal flagged that. Keep product claims quantifiable and conservative.

ruth.content: Copy is ready in two flavors. Short headline A: "Serve faster, spend less." Headline B: "Inference tuned for scale and cost." I'll drop both in Figma comments with alt text. Also need a 40-char social caption for each hero.

kai.design: Ok will produce wireframes and keep the infographic as an SVG without rasterized text. Plan: icons for batching / KV cache / quantization, 3-step visual flow (requests -> optimizations -> cost/latency outcome). Exports: SVG for diagram, PNG @2x for tiles and metric card, and Figma components using brand tokens.

erin.marketing: Can we also get a logo-free version for syndication partners and a version with no copy for creative reuse?

kai.design: Yep to both. Timeline: wireframes in 18h, first comps in 30h, finals in 48h. Prioritizing infographic + landscape hero first. I'll tag reviewers in the file.

brand-bot: Reminder: brand palette tokens to use: --rw-blue-600, --rw-ink-900, --rw-accent-300. Avoid non-approved typography.

devin.pm: Great. If legal pushes back on copy, fallback headline: "Optimized inference for production workloads."

ruth.content: I'll prep alt text and short captions in the figma comments so exports are deploy-ready.

kai.design: Checklist I'm tracking: 1) infographic SVG + slide PNG, 2) landscape hero (light/dark) + square hero, 3) metric card, 4) logo-free & no-copy variants, 5) PNG @2x + optimized SVGs, 6) one-paragraph usage note. Will update thread when first frames posted.

erin.marketing: Thanks team 44d scheduling a 20-min review slot after comps are up. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
